title: Beach Flags
tagline: Sprint, dive and grab the last flag on the sand.
description: The beach sprint of Australian surf lifesaving carnivals. Lie flat, spin on the whistle, tap in rhythm, steer to a flag and dive for it: there is always one flag fewer than racers. Cups, Sudden Death, a Daily Beach and Watch & Learn modes.
howToPlay: Lie flat until the whistle, then tap once to spin and get up.
Tap in a steady rhythm: stay in the gold window of the rhythm bar.
Tap to the side of your runner to steer towards a flag.
Press DIVE when the flag is close to stretch for it.
One flag is missing every round: be the racer who holds the last one.
